predictor: Existing Store candidate mapping: not flagged→unrelated, flagged score>=80→duplicate candidate, other flagged→related candidate. No official relationship decision.
thresholdProtocol: Defaults fixed before evaluation; no tuning performed on tuning or held-out labels. Preserve this baseline before Phase 6 changes. Different-institution gating is part of the pipeline, not an embedding result.

tuning.macroPolicy: Mean over labels with actual support or predictions; undefined precision/recall contributes zero for such a label. No samples -> null. Per-class absent denominators remain null.
